name: Who is in the room
useWhen: Four to six people placed by role and location at the top of a meeting. Not biographies.

focal.note: Diameter against headline size. The faces are the slide; the headline only frames them, which is why it can be the one thing set in orange caps without competing.

replacesNote: Does not replace team-v1 — that is three wide portraits with real bios, a different job. Keep both.

deviations.why: The source's portraits are wide enough to hold the names; the wrap is a defect, not a style.
